C0027.title: Yunchao Technology Fined 2.4 Million Yuan for Unfair Competition
C0027.summary: The Haidian District Market Supervision Administration of Beijing determined that Yunchao Technology engaged in unfair competitive practices, including poaching customers, misappropriating prototype devices, and tampering with client backend software systems, in violation of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China, and imposed an administrative fine of 2.4 million yuan.

references.title: ...Seizing Customers, Misappropriating Samples, Tampering with Customer Backend Software Systems; Penalized for Unfair Competition
